incarnation: Infernum: Nine Pits — Mercy Ash individual currently selected V2 portrait, original project canon2026

references.provenance: Exact tracked V2 Git LFS object recovered locally, same bitmap currently selected by HEROES_DB and production.audiovisual.

silhouette: Slender human feminine figure, upright head and high windswept ponytail; full-length tattered plum cloak/coat, long dark trousers and strapped boots.
anatomy: Two human arms and two legs, five fingers when individually readable; pale ash-grey skin, preserve apparent source age/proportions without inventing a number.
face: Pale ash face, amber eyes, dark brows, dark lips, restrained serious expression; tiny source facial markings are not fully resolvable.
costume: Deep dark-plum long-sleeved coat and ragged cape with amber/gold lining/edging, broad amber scarf/collar; dark fitted leather torso with multiple brown straps and belts, dark trousers, black laced/strapped shin boots, wrapped dark grey forearms and fingerless gloves.
palette: Near-black, dark plum, ashen grey, weathered brass/gold and orange ember; no white tank top, red waist sash or blue harem trousers from the divergent old atlas.
distinguishingMarks: Very dark purple-black messy high ponytail held by small gold bands; ragged plum cape flows behind her; amber collar and fine gold hardware/chains.
equipment: Source-visible long dark segmented pole with weathered brass fittings, one large crescent scythe blade edged with orange ember-light. Anatomical RIGHT hand controls the shaft; LEFT hand holds the hanging linked chain. Chain belongs to this same weapon; no second scythe, handgun or generic sword.
forbiddenMixes: The previous tank-top unarmed atlas is retained as a historical variant and is not the V2 identity authority.
No real-world religious iconography, franchise symbols, imported demon characters or invented readable runes.
Gameplay colour/weaponType alone is not independent canon evidence; the depicted source pole-scythe takes priority over generic chain_sickle shorthand.

scopeLimitations: Original internal Multiverse Breach character; selected HEROES_DB portrait and production.audiovisual.portrait are the same individual V2 source, not an external franchise reference.
One pixel-art view leaves tiny face markings, exact eye detail, hidden coat construction and chain attachment uncertain; preserve observed relationships and do not certify perfect1:1.
Source appears as an ash-skinned condemned guide; no chronological age is invented. New settings and poses are original compositions coherent with Infernum lore.
Old atlas shows a tan unarmed martial artist in light tank top/red sash/loose blue trousers; retained unchanged, not identity-qualified.
CG05 is a Nexus gameplay adaptation;CG09-11 Fan Art;CG12-15 explicit What If. Transformations preserve identifying hair/palette/equipment motif; source identity is not rewritten.
